name: christianmacion-portfolio
description: Christian T. Macion — AI Engineer + Quantitative Researcher. Personal portfolio site.

scripts.prebuild: node scripts/build-resumes.mjs && node scripts/build-resumes-md.mjs && node scripts/build-og-image.mjs && node scripts/optimize-assets.mjs && node scripts/fetch-gdelt.mjs && node scripts/fetch-arxiv.mjs && node scripts/fetch-macrowire.mjs && node scripts/build-graph-snapshot.mjs && node scripts/build-live-feed.mjs
scripts.build:mirror: BUILD_DATE=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) BASE_PATH=/ PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://christianmacion-portfolio.pages.dev astro build && node scripts/build-llms-full.mjs && cp public/llms-full.txt dist/llms-full.txt && node scripts/asset-audit.mjs && pagefind --site dist --output-subdir _pagefind && npm run no-f14
scripts.deploy:mirror: npm run build:mirror && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name christianmacion-portfolio --commit-dirty=true --branch main
scripts.scripts:feeds: npm run scripts:fetch-gdelt && npm run scripts:fetch-arxiv && npm run scripts:fetch-macrowire
scripts.postbuild: node scripts/asset-audit.mjs && pagefind --site dist --output-subdir _pagefind && python3 tools/scorecard_aggregator.py
scripts.ci: npm run lint:md && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run knip && npm run no-bulbs && npm run build && npm run verify:anchors && npm run no-f14 && npm run no-halo && npm run bundle:budget && npm run perf:audit && npm run a11y:scan && npm run contrast:check && npm run headings:check && npm run link:rot && npm run anchor:rot && npm run link:target:validity && npm run live:integrity && npm run meta:integrity && npm run feed:integrity && npm run sitemap:integrity && npm run jsonld:integrity && npm run og:integrity && npm run canonical:url:integrity && npm run hreflang:integrity && npm run favicon:integrity && npm run image:alt:integrity && npm run structured:data:coverage && npm run robots:txt:integrity && npm run security:headers:integrity && npm run build:output:integrity && npm run internal:link:graph:integrity && npm run content:freshness:integrity && npm run frontmatter:required:fields && npm run cross:reference:integrity && npm run image:dimension:attributes && npm run webp:availability && npm run picture:source:pairing && npm run picture:count && npm run picture:source:order && npm run picture:source:srcset && npm run picture:source:srcset:resolves && npm run picture:img:fallback:resolves && npm run raster:img:outside:picture && npm run img:loading:attribute && npm run img:decoding:attribute && npm run img:fetchpriority:attribute && npm run site:chrome:coverage && npm run heading:hierarchy:skip && npm run heading:uniqueness && npm run form:input:label:association && npm run skip:link:presence && npm run button:accessible:name && npm run link:accessible:name && npm run video:caption:track && npm run table:headers:presence && npm run video:audio:stream && npm run duplicate:id:presence && npm run audit && npm run sitemap:check
scripts.button:accessible:name: node scripts/check-button-accessible-name.mjs
scripts.link:accessible:name: node scripts/check-link-accessible-name.mjs
scripts.no-halo: grep -rn 'box-shadow:\s*0\s*0\s*[1-9][0-9]' src/ 2>/dev/null && echo 'FAIL: halo/glow box-shadow detected' && exit 1 || echo 'PASS: no halo/glow box-shadows'
